name: Clip Mask Viewer Host Validation Exerciser
description: Task-local exerciser for the clip-mask viewer's exact-host read path: clip-mask record matrix, selection bridge, plugin registration lifecycle, and status notification.

permissions.reason: Reads clip-mask records, ArtMesh snapshots, and the editor selection on the exact host for validation evidence.
Contributes and closes a task-local collapsible section in the Turboism panel to validate the registration lifecycle.
Registers and closes a task-local action twice to validate the action registry lifecycle.
Registers and closes a task-local Turboism menu item to validate the menu registry lifecycle.
Reports probe completion through the status surface (best effort).
